title: Match rule (contract 5.2, schema_version 0.1)
description: One line of data/runs/<match_id>/rules.jsonl (Stage 5.5): one rule AI Blue invented in this match that passed the validator and the per-match cap, in creation order. The AI wrote only 'conditions'; the body filled rule_id, cwe (= the label Blue gave the line), source_request_id (from the local index, D8), created_at_log_seq (the line it was proposed on) and created_match. hot_loaded: true in rules mode 'on' (the rule labels every later matching line without an API call, D4/D9), false in mode 'shadow' (recorded and scored, never applied). Every line of one file has the same hot_loaded. Blue never reads it back within a match; Red never reads it.
